purpose: Explain the nested Engineering Safety Full Audit and Pontual Audit tabs, shared project-root ownership, immediate visual sonar cancellation with safe worker settlement, canonical KANDA green sonar background ownership, existing command launcher, and advisory authority boundary.
display_lines: Engineering Safety remains inside Audit Project beside Architecture Review.
Full Audit provides Complete Enginneering Review, cooperative Cancel Review, and KANDA's canonical floating green sonar activity monitor while the worker is active.
Cancel Review stops and hides the sonar immediately; the active command still settles before controls return to idle.
The sonar preserves the canonical greenSonarActivityPanel object name and gradient background used by other KANDA workflows.
Engineering Safety reuses the public GreenSonarActivityMonitor template and does not maintain a duplicate radar painter.
Pontual Audit preserves the original Engineering Safety tool groups and output window.
Engineering Safety uses the single Project Root selector in the shared Audit Project header and does not duplicate Browse controls.
Interactive Ruff Corrections remains manual and Engineering Safety does not authorize patching or freezing.
